title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Adding Notification to Parties of the Provisions of Article 232 of the Civil Procedure Law in Civil Judgments
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Adding a Notice to Parties in Civil Judgments Regarding the Content of Article 232 of the Civil Procedure Law

Fa [2007] No. 19

All local people's courts at various levels, all military courts, all railway transport intermediate and basic courts, all maritime courts, and all courts of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

In accordance with the requirement of the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Several Major Issues Concerning Building a Socialist Harmonious Society" regarding "implementing the system of informing parties of their rights and obligations", and in order to enable the prevailing party to timely obtain litigation results and to urge the losing party to timely fulfill obligations, it is hereby decided, upon deliberation, to add in civil judgments that contain monetary payment content, the notice to parties regarding the provisions of Article 232 of the Civil Procedure Law. The specific manner of expression in civil judgments is hereby notified as follows:

1. In a judgment of first instance that includes a monetary payment obligation, the following sentence shall be written on a new line after all adjudicative items: "If the obligation to pay money is not performed within the period specified in this judgment, doubled interest on the debt for the period of delayed performance shall be paid in accordance with the provisions of Article 232 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC."

2. In a case where the judgment of second instance modifies the original judgment, regardless of whether the first instance judgment included the above notice content, the notice content specified in item 1 shall be written on a new line after all adjudicative items.

3. If the first instance judgment has already included the above notice content, a judgment of second instance that affirms the original judgment need not repeat the notice.

It is hereby notified.

February 7, 2007
